Preset.Comment: Classic DX electric piano. Op3 at 14x ratio gives the metallic 'tine' attack on top of the body.
Three inharmonic modulators on one carrier — pure crystal bell with no fundamental colour from sustain.
Bright, percussive mallet — hard attack from a 4x modulator and very fast envelopes.
All three modulators at full level on inharmonic ratios — heavy clangorous bell.
Soft mallet with a slightly slower attack and a long resonant decay. Op2 at 4x for the metallic shimmer.
Two parallel chains: 5th-harmonic-stack and unison-octave-stack. Sharp attack, sustained body.
Bushy alg with mods cascading into mods — bright, punchy hit that decays to a duller body.
Mixed alg: one modulated chain plus two parallel detuned carriers — bright cluster on attack.
Bushy alg cranked up — high modulator levels at high ratios for an in-your-face stab.
Slow-attack version of Brass Stab — same dual-chain structure, swelling envelope.
Detuned dual-chain pad. Op1/Op3 modulators slightly off-tune for a chorused string-section feel.
One mod feeding three detuned carriers (unison, 5th, octave) — choir-like layered swell.
Pure additive — four sines at octave-stack ratios with descending levels. Very clean, glassy.
Twin-pair alg: shared modulator feeds two carriers at 1 and 2 ratios with detune. Warm and broad.
Twin-pair with inharmonic modulator ratios — slowly evolving metallic texture.
One bright modulated carrier plus two parallel clean ones. Cuts through a mix.
Pure additive drawbar — fundamental + octave + 5th + 2nd-octave with descending levels.
Classic Hammond 88 8000 drawbar setup: 16' (sub), 5 1/3' (5th), 8' (unity), 4' silenced.
Four-octave pipe stack: 16', 8', 4', 2' — slow attack for a swelling cathedral feel.
Linear chain lead with 2x modulator near the carrier — bright, cutting, monophonic-style.
Two-carrier 5th-and-unity lead — the absent fundamental gives a hollow, woodwind-ish quality.
Bushy alg with 4x feeder mod — aggressive, sawtooth-like solo voice.
One mod into three detuned carriers at 1/2/3 ratios — resonant, mid-rangey clavi-style sound.
Linear chain with 2x modulator for FM-bass character. Punchy attack, medium body.
Two carriers at unity (op2) and -1 octave (op4) — low-octave-doubled clean fundamental.
Bushy alg for a snappier, brighter bass with attack character. Good for short bass stabs.
Generic clean pluck — chain with 1.5x mod for slight inharmonicity, immediate decay.
Three-on-one with high-ratio inharmonic mods — short, glassy bell-pluck.
Dual-chain pluck — 5th harmonic (op1->op2) layered with 3rd harmonic (op3->op4). Wooden character.
Three-on-one alg with deeply inharmonic ratios — shimmering metal sheet on a sustaining carrier.
Twin-pair with very long attack — modulator levels rise gradually, opening up the timbre over seconds.
Pure additive with the 'whistle' band (octave-up) loudest, plus subtle fundamental and high partials.
